'''Raab Rannon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He was assigned to the [[Science and Research|Research branch]] of the Alliance under [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raab Rannon appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a Sith Inquisitor vendor.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
